images.purpose: Chia yêu cầu lớn thành các phần chức năng nhỏ, có thứ tự và kiểm chứng.
images.prompt:
Create ONE standalone 16:9 horizontal editorial illustration, the first in a coherent three-image Vietnamese series explaining skills in Vietnam Agentic Skills. Use case: illustration-story.
Skill being explained: planning-and-task-breakdown. Actual takeaway: turn a big requirement into ordered small tasks, each delivering working testable functionality; establish dependencies and acceptance checks.
Physical metaphor: on a simple low workbench, an oversized laminated construction block representing one overwhelming project has three clearly visible structural layers (foundation stones, simple mechanical cogs, small window outlines). Muc Den (Ink), a small solid-black irregular bean creature with two white dot eyes, very thin stick arms and legs, blank serious face, is straining earnestly to pull a taut wire cutter down through this massive block. Three manageable vertical slices already stand separately to the right, numbered 1, 2, 3, each preserving ALL three layers, each with its own little dangling paper inspection tag bearing a black checkmark. A single thin orange line links their feet in order, with tiny arrowheads. No cake, food, candles, weapons or fancy machinery. This is a dry absurd workshop scene: cut work into complete working slices rather than disconnected technical layers. The character must be physically cutting, never merely pointing.
Pure clean white #FFFFFF background, fine slightly wobbly black hand-drawn ink outlines, mostly sparse line work, solid black only on character and tiny details. Main scene occupies 50-60% of canvas, centered with very generous margins and at least 35% blank space. Sparse blue handwritten notes, restrained red highlighting around one acceptance check, orange only for order line. No gradients, shadows, paper texture, polished vector rendering, 3D, cute cartoon, corporate slide, infographic grid or realistic app UI.
Only these short Vietnamese handwritten labels, accurate diacritics: "Yêu cầu lớn" near original block, "Việc nhỏ" near slices, "Đúng thứ tự" near orange path, "Kiểm chứng" near hanging check tags. At bottom center a small black handwritten caption "Chia nhỏ để làm được" and below in smaller clean legible text "planning-and-task-breakdown". No top-left header, no other text. Charming deadpan conceptual sketch, never childish. PNG.

images.purpose: Lần theo bằng chứng để tìm nguyên nhân gốc trước khi sửa.
images.prompt:
Create ONE standalone 16:9 horizontal editorial illustration, image two in a Vietnamese series explaining repository skills. Use case: illustration-story. Explain the actual skill systematic-debugging: reproduce a symptom, trace evidence to its source, test a hypothesis, and verify the fix instead of making random patches. Express just the central lesson: investigate the root cause first.
Scene and fresh metaphor: one long, strange, thin hand-drawn plumbing pipe starts at the upper left, loops once in the middle and ends at the lower right above a spreading puddle. In the middle, a small faulty coupling has a tiny red crack and a couple of escaping drops. Muc Den (Ink), a small irregular solid-black bean-bodied worker with two white dot eyes and thin stick arms and legs, blank deadpan expression, has physically climbed partly inside an oversized handheld magnifying-glass ring and uses its handle as a lever to position the glass directly over the faulty coupling. The coupling is enlarged through the lens. A delicate orange dotted tracing path runs backwards along the pipe from the puddle at right toward this coupling, making the act of following evidence upstream unambiguous. A small unused bandage lies by the puddle, with one restrained red diagonal strike: patching the visible symptom is insufficient. Only one primary scene, no comic panels. Character actively investigates, no idle pointing, no repair already completed, no claim all errors are solved.
White #FFFFFF background. Minimalist black fine hand-drawn line art, naturally imperfect pen strokes, lots of breathing room. Main scene fills about 50-60% of frame with broad blank white margins and at least 35% white space. Sparse blue handwritten labels, tiny red crack/warning, orange only for tracing path. No shadows, gradients, grain, beige paper, cute mascot, childish face, slick vector art, formal flowchart, corporate slide, dense diagram, realistic UI or extra props.
Short readable Vietnamese labels with correct diacritics: "Triệu chứng" at puddle, "Lần theo dấu vết" near tracing path, "Nguyên nhân gốc" near magnified coupling, "Đừng vá mò" beside unused bandage. Small black centered handwritten caption below scene: "Tìm gốc trước khi sửa"; below it smaller legible text "systematic-debugging". Do not put a header at top-left. No other readable words. PNG.
